mission.goal: Deliver a provider-neutral production foundation that deterministically decomposes, allocates, load-balances, joins, verifies, cancels and recovers bounded multi-stream work while preserving authority, privacy, cost and proof boundaries.
mission.workflow: RECONCILE_NOT_REBUILD: Formation Reconciliation Fabric v2 plus SOL 6.1 plus isolated Omega-One PR 843 candidate semantics.
mission.data: Typed mission, task, capability, result, receipt, checkpoint, telemetry and proof records; secret values and private provider locators are prohibited.
mission.interface: Implemented local omega-completion CLI demo plus Python work-engine API, including topology-aware concurrency planning, bounded scheduling waves, persistence status and online-backup operations; additional operational commands remain future scope.
mission.stack: Python 3.11+ standard-library-first package; SQLite WAL transactional state store; Omega-One contracts and telemetry; SOL 6.1 runtime primitives.
mission.environment: Local deterministic no-effect development and CI foundation; provider adapters disabled by default.
mission.governance: Formation-gated A0-A3 separation, zero-new-recurring-cost default, zero-dilution proof maturity, single effect gateway and independent readback.
mission.failure: Fail closed on stale mission state, authority/privacy/cost uncertainty, provider drift, shared-write conflicts, missing proof, uncertain external outcome or cancellation.
mission.testing: Seventy-two local unit/integration tests and sixteen adversarial invariants passed. The H2-P paired five-boundary process-kill canary recovered every mission and cleared speed, projection, recovery, integrity and fairness gates, but failed proof-receipt exactly-once quality; multi-host, live-provider, hidden-suite, soak and real-media courts remain required before readiness.
mission.deployment: No deployment is authorized or claimed by this contract. A future target requires a separate permit, canary, health, persistence, rollback and semantic readback.
mission.continuity: SQLite transactional revisions, append-only control events, idempotency reservations, durable admission and dispatch-transition outbox recovery, online backup, leases, fencing, dead-letter state, explicit resume conditions and AI handoff files.

assumptions.stack: Python 3.11+ and setuptools; no mandatory runtime dependency beyond the standard library at foundation stage.
assumptions.runtime: One root orchestrator owns bounded fan-out/fan-in; child concurrency cannot exceed the root budget.
assumptions.storage: Local SQLite WAL schema v2 with FULL synchronous commits, revision fencing, append-only control events and durable admission/dispatch-transition outboxes for deterministic same-host operation; a multi-host datastore and leader-election path remain unresolved.
assumptions.authentication: Provider credentials are never read by the core. Future adapters consume opaque authorized references and must prove current identity and scope.
assumptions.deployment: No target runtime, provider deployment or recurring infrastructure spend is assumed.

components.frontend: NOT_APPLICABLE: CLI-first foundation; no graphical frontend is required for the current mission.
components.backend: Implemented omega_one.work_engine mission governor and deterministic fan-out/fan-in coordinator composed over inherited Omega-One and SOL modules.
components.database: Implemented normalized SQLite WAL transactional store with schema versioning, optimistic revision fencing, integrity checks, source-preserving legacy JSON migration and online backup; this is same-host proof only.
components.queue: SOL DurableWorkerPlane-compatible durable queue with transactionally unique idempotency reservations, durable admission and dispatch-transition outboxes, idempotent partial sidecar materialization, leases, retries, dead-letter routing and checkpoint references.
components.worker: SOL worker/coordinator primitives wrapped by typed Omega-One task/result contracts and mission-version fencing.
components.scheduler: Root-owned DAG scheduler with hard vetoes, topology/critical-depth awareness, adaptive READY-frontier and worker-capacity width, weighted fairness, one-revision multi-lease waves, affinity and provider capacity scoring.
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: correctness cannot depend on a cache; any future cache is an optimization with independent invalidation tests.
components.storage: Incrementally committed top-level records and hash-validated append-only control events stored in SQLite; inherited SOL worker/audit sidecars remain byte-preserved and are recovered idempotently from admission or dispatch-transition intent after interruption.
components.authentication: Default-deny provider adapter admission; opaque secret references only; maker-credential Copilot autonomous triggers prohibited.

observability.correlation_ids: Mission, task, attempt, provider request and parent/child trace identities on every material event.
observability.health_checks: Required local status checks for event-chain integrity, queue state, lease age, provider flags and proof freshness.
observability.structured_logs: Secret-safe CloudEvent-shaped records with bounded recursively redacted data.
observability.audit_logs: Append-only hash-chained audit journal with tamper verification and cancellation/recovery events.
observability.metrics_alerts: Queue depth/age, active leases, latency, retries, cancellations, breaker state, cost, proof age and false-completion signals.

invariants: No authority, privacy, cost or proof inheritance across providers.
Remote delivery is at-least-once plus idempotency and reconciliation.
Duplicate or conflicting idempotency keys are rejected before any state-plane mutation.
Integrity verification reconciles every control task with its exact worker job and idempotency index entry.
Detached later-stage evidence cannot promote over a missing predecessor.
A failed or fenced state commit publishes no partial control-state revision.
Exactly one same-host contender may reserve an idempotency key; losing contenders cannot mutate mission, task, job, index or outbox state.
Committed admissions survive interruption between the control transaction and inherited-sidecar materialization and are replayed idempotently on restart.
A multi-lease dispatch wave advances one control revision and records one durable transition intent before inherited worker-sidecar publication.
Partial dispatch-wave materialization is replayed idempotently; a matching existing lease is accepted and missing leases are completed.
Effectful tasks and proof completion remain on single-item paths and are excluded from multi-item transaction coalescing.
Full H2 is not admitted while process-kill recovery can replay RESULT or INDEPENDENT_PROOF receipts.

Controlled quota, saturation, timeout, partial-output, stale-version and uncertain-outcome fixtures.
failure_first: Unauthorized or privacy-incompatible route never reaches an adapter.
Gemini managed-agent/A2A preview routes are disabled by default.
Copilot maker-credential autonomous trigger is rejected.
Expired leases recover or dead-letter without double credit.
Repeated unchanged failure opens its circuit.
Duplicate or conflicting idempotency admission produces zero mission, task, worker-job, index or outbox mutation.
Injected failure before commit rolls back the complete state revision.
Malformed or already-imported legacy state fails closed or remains idempotent without destroying the source.
A schema-v2 dispatch wave survives post-commit interruption and partial inherited-sidecar materialization without duplicate leases or pending intent after restart.

resume_conditions: Provider capability, authority, privacy and cost state is refreshed.
